manual.blueprints.line2: The following pages feature all the Engineer's Blueprints that can be crafted by normal means. Other specialized Blueprints may need to be acquired from villagers or found in the world.{0}
manual.blueprints.line3: All of these blueprints, including specialized ones, can be used in an {0}Engineer's Workbench{1} to craft the items they describe.
